Load Data

df <- read_excel("../03_Data/China_merged_2024.xlsx")
New names:
• `` -> `...1`
China_full <- df %>% 
  select(headline, abstract, Merged, section, query_date)
China_full$contains_trump <- ifelse(grepl("Trump", China_full$headline), 1, 0)
table(China_full$contains_trump)

   0    1 
3741  500

Pre-processing

China_full$Merged <- gsub("[‘’´`]", "'", China_full$Merged)  #Turn all
China_full$Merged<- gsub("'", "", China_full$Merged) 

data_tokens <- tokens(
    China_full$Merged,
    remove_numbers = TRUE,
    remove_punct = TRUE,
    remove_symbols = TRUE,
    remove_separators = TRUE,
    remove_url = TRUE
  ) %>%
  tokens_tolower() %>%
  tokens_remove(
    c(stopwords("english"),
      "briefing",'u.s','monday','tuesday','wednesday', 'chinese','china', "chinas", "trumps",
      "biden's",'Thursday','Frida','Saturday','can','year','like'
    )
  ) %>%
  tokens_select(min_nchar = 2)
data_dfm <- dfm(data_tokens) %>%
              dfm_trim(min_termfreq = 2, min_docfreq = 2)
ncol(data_dfm)
[1] 6797
keyATM_docs <- keyATM_read(texts = data_dfm)
ℹ Using quanteda dfm.
summary(keyATM_docs)

Keyword Selection

keywords <- list(
  APAC = c('taiwan', 'korea', 'hong', 'kong', 'japan'),
  Election  = c('election', 'vote','siena', 'poll'),
  Economy = c('economy', 'market', 'stock'),
  Foreign_Policy = c('putin','russia','ukraine', 'iran','israel','gaza'),
  Olympics =  c('olympics', 'tracking'),
  Technology = c('tiktok', 'a.i','electric', 'cars','vehicles', 'tech'),
  Trade = c('trade', 'tariffs', 'imports', 'exports')
)
key_viz <- visualize_keywords(docs = keyATM_docs, keywords = keywords)
key_viz
#ggsave("China_keyword_dis.png")

  US_Politics = c('trump','republican','vance', 'electorate','democrats','biden','harris')
)
key_viz <- visualize_keywords(docs = keyATM_docs, keywords = keywords)
key_viz
#ggsave("China_political_dis.png")
keywords_combined <- list(
  APAC = c('taiwan', 'korea', 'hong', 'kong', 'japan'),
  Election  = c('election', 'vote','siena', 'poll'),
  Economy = c('economy', 'market', 'stock'),
  Foreign_Policy = c('putin','russia','ukraine', 'iran','israel','gaza'),
  Olympics =  c('olympics', 'tracking'),
  Technology = c('tiktok', 'a.i','cars','electric','vehicles', 'tech'),
  Trade = c('trade', 'tariffs', 'imports', 'export'),
  US_Politics = c('trump','republican','vance', 'electorate','democrats','biden','harris')
)
#If keyword all included then there should be no error
key_viz <- visualize_keywords(docs = keyATM_docs, keywords = keywords_combined)

KeyATM

#default is 1500
my_options <- list(
  seed          = 250, 
  iterations    = 100)

key_model <- keyATM(
  docs      = keyATM_docs, # text input
  no_keyword_topics = 4, 
  keywords  = keywords_combined, # keywords
  model     = "base",     
  options   = my_options,  #       
)

Topic Distribution

topic_dis <- values_fig(plot_pi(key_model))
ℹ Plotting pi from the final MCMC draw. Please set `store_pi` to `TRUE` if you want to plot pi over iterations.
library(ggplot2)

# Make sure Topic is ordered by Probability or by original order
topic_dis$Topic <- factor(topic_dis$Topic, levels = topic_dis$Topic)

# Plot
estimated_count_vish <- ggplot(topic_dis, aes(x = Topic, y = Probability)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Probability of Topics (keyATM Estimated)", x = "Topic", y = "Probability") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))  # Rotate x-axis labels

estimated_count_vish
#ggsave("China_keyATM_topic_dis.png")

Covariates

vars_selected <- data.frame(contains_trump = China_full$contains_trump)
out <- keyATM(
  docs              = keyATM_docs,
  no_keyword_topics = 5,
  keywords          = keywords_combined,
  model             = "covariates",
  model_settings    = list(
    covariates_data    = vars_selected,
    covariates_formula = ~ contains_trump
  ),
  options = my_options,
)
ℹ Convert covariates data using `model_settings$covariates_formula`.
